method: TypeScript 5.4.5 AST over all tracked JS/TS files, independently compared with filename-based manifest. Literal .each tables expanded; source ranges, inherited suites, modifiers, hooks, imports and local fixture graph preserved.
limitations: Static analysis cannot prove runtime collection completeness for arbitrary JavaScript execution, eval, computed property calls or test plugins. No claim of exhaustive runtime collection until full Vitest and typecheck collection succeeds.

The 905 records are finite statically discovered instances, not 905 ports. Only literal each tables are expanded. Nested describe parameterization, nonliteral cases, loops or helper-generated cases require unresolved classification and runtime collection.

Assertion expressions are source expressions, not the count of runtime assertion invocations; async branches can execute differently. Complete module source plus pinned baseline remains authoritative.
Type tests require Go success/failure fixtures or retained SDK tests. Merely retaining TS source does not implement or pass them.
Simulation is a seeded, app-parameterized external-RPC harness with unbounded seeds, not a finite Vitest test file. It is separately inventoried and remains unported/unexecuted.
SDK/React ownership is retained separately; compatibility against Go requires original clients interacting with the Go server.

SIM_PARAMS = {
  RPC_ERROR_RATE: pick([0, 0.02, 0.05], "rpc-error-rate"),
  DB_ERROR_RATE: pick([0, 0.001, 0.001], "db-error-rate"),
  DB_ERROR_RATE_TRANSACTION: pick(
    [0, 0.00005, 0.00005],
    "db-error-rate-transaction",
  ),
  MAX_UNCACHED_BLOCKS: CACHED_APPS.includes(APP_ID)
    ? 0
    : pick([0, 0, 0, 100, 250], "max-uncached-blocks"),
  SUPER_ASSESSMENT_FILTER_RATE: pick(
    [0, 0.25, 0.5],
    "super-assessment-filter-rate",
  ),
  ETH_GET_LOGS_RESPONSE_LIMIT: pick(
    [1000, 10_000, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],
    "eth-get-logs-response-limit",
  ),
  ETH_GET_LOGS_BLOCK_LIMIT: pick(
    [100, 1000, 10_000, Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],
    "eth-get-logs-block-limit",
  ),
  REALTIME_REORG_RATE: pick([0, 0.02, 0.05], "realtime-reorg-rate"),
  REALTIME_DEEP_REORG_RATE: pick([0, 0.01, 0.02], "realtime-deep-reorg-rate"),
  REALTIME_FAST_FORWARD_RATE: pick(
    [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75],
    "realtime-fast-forward-rate",
  ),
  REALTIME_DELAY_RATE: pick([0, 0.4, 0.8], "realtime-delay-rate"),
  UNFINALIZED_BLOCKS: pick([0, 0, 50, 100, 250, 300], "unfinalized-blocks"),
  REALTIME_SHUTDOWN_RATE:
    APP_ID === "super-assessment"
      ? undefined
      : pick([0, 0.001, 0.002], "realtime-shutdown-rate"),
  ORDERING:
    APP_ID === "assessment"
      ? pick(["multichain", "omnichain", "experimental_isolated"], "ordering")
      : pick(["multichain", "omnichain"], "ordering"),
  REALTIME_BLOCK_HAS_TRANSACTIONS: pick(
    [true, false],
    "realtime-block-has-transactions",
  ),
  CACHE_RPC_REQUESTS: IN_MEMORY_SYNC_APPS.includes(APP_ID)
    ? pick([true, false], "cache-rpc-requests")
    : true,
}
